description.p: Work with Figma in a native GNOME window. Open documents in tabs, browse them in the tab overview, and use installed fonts.
Select for Figma uses Chromium to display Figma and GTK 4 with libadwaita for its desktop interface. Inspired by ReSketch.
Use the Select for Figma name consistently for the application ID, resources, package paths, and development tools, while migrating existing saved data and KeePassXC connections.
Restore the select-for-figma command used by desktop launchers and scripts.
First stable GTK release, with an Adwaita editor theme and a Ctrl+Tab thumbnail switcher that includes Home and supports tab position or most recently used order.
